mapper.select: SELECT card_package_rel.end_time, contract_device.id, contract_device.cpe_id, cpe_device.device_sn, cpe_device.device_status_no, cpe_device.device_module_no, cpe_device.device_type_no, cpe_device.card_no, cpe_device.online_card_no, cpe_device.online_net_no, cpe_device.position, cpe_device.memo, cpe_device.online_band, cpe_device.five_g_module, cpe_device.sys_org_code FROM contract_device LEFT OUTER JOIN cpe_device ON contract_device.cpe_id = cpe_device.id LEFT OUTER JOIN card_info ON cpe_device.card_no = card_info.id LEFT OUTER JOIN card_package_rel ON card_info.id = card_package_rel.card_id WHERE contract_id = #{mainId}
